================================================================================
PIPELINE OVERVIEW
================================================================================

Trigger Events:
  - Push to main/develop/feature/* branches
  - Pull requests to main/develop
  - Manual workflow dispatch
  - Scheduled: Mon/Wed/Daily

Jobs: 11 total
  - test-matrix (3 parallel Python versions: 3.11, 3.12, 3.13)
  - quality-gates (coverage enforcement)
  - security-checks (SARIF reports)
  - integration-test
  - build-check
  - dependency-check (weekly)
  - security-audit (weekly)
  - performance-baseline (daily)
  - license-check (on-demand)
  - health-check-summary
  - report-summary

Duration: ~10 minutes per push/PR
Parallel execution: All jobs run in parallel for speed
